name: 滿版輪播＋左側標題組，下方窄條放分頁點
desc: 滿版的圖片或影片自動輪播，左側中段疊大標題、副標與按鈕；背景下方一條窄條置中放分頁點。
prompt: 背景為多張滿版圖片或影片組成的自動輪播，貼齊畫面左右兩側與主視覺頂端，呈寬幅比例。背景左側中段（垂直位置略偏上）疊一組文字，靠左對齊頁面內容寬度：大標題（可多行），約佔畫面寬的四分之一；標題下方可放副標，副標下方可放一顆按鈕（桌機只放一顆），沒有內容時省略，其他元素的位置不變。副標寬度不超過畫面寬的一半，按鈕明顯小於標題；文字組右側留給背景畫面。每張停留數秒後切換到下一張，大標題、副標與按鈕跟著每張一起換，播完最後一張後回到第一張繼續。
mobile: 底邊仍約在畫面八成高的位置，下方露出下一個區塊的開頭。背景改為直式裁切。文字組從左側中段移到背景的左下角，仍靠左對齊，大標題寬度改為接近畫面寬的一半；副標下方可放一到兩顆按鈕，兩顆時上下堆疊，沒有內容時省略。分頁點仍在背景下方的窄條置中。自動輪播保留。

en.name: Full-bleed slideshow with a left text group and a pagination strip below
en.desc: An auto-playing slideshow of full-bleed images or videos with a headline, subheading and button layered at the middle-left; a narrow strip below the background holds centered pagination dots.
en.prompt: The background is an auto-playing slideshow of multiple full-bleed images or videos, flush with the left and right edges of the viewport and the top of the hero, in a wide format. A text group is layered at the middle of the left side of the background (vertically slightly above center), left-aligned to the page content width: a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), about a quarter of the viewport width. Optionally place a subheading below the headline and a single button below the subheading (only one button on desktop); omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. The subheading is no wider than half the viewport, the button is clearly smaller than the headline, and the area to the right of the text group is left to the background. Each slide stays for a few seconds and then changes to the next; the headline, subheading and button change together with each slide, and after the last slide it returns to the first and continues.
en.mobile: The bottom edge still sits at about eighty percent of the viewport height, revealing the start of the next section below. The background is cropped to portrait. The text group moves from the middle of the left side to the bottom-left corner of the background, still left-aligned, and the headline becomes about half the viewport width; optionally place one or two buttons below the subheading, stacked vertically when there are two, and omit them when there is no content. The pagination dots stay centered in the strip below the background. The auto-playing slideshow is kept.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺底部整列放一條窄條，窄條緊接在背景下緣下方、不疊在背景上，正中央放一組輪播分頁點，目前這張的點較明顯。

en.prompt: In a full-width row along the bottom of the hero, place a narrow strip directly below the bottom edge of the background, not over it, with a set of slideshow pagination dots centered in it; the dot for the current slide stands out.
